title: University of Cagliari people collect the artifacts and giant bodies

tellings.quote: certain individuals who were associated with the University of Kajetti, the capital city in Sardinia.

plain: Between about 1978 and 1981, people connected to the University of Cagliari, in Sardinia's capital city, collected ancient artifacts and the bodies of giants found on the island, according to Tim Alberino, a filmmaker who has investigated giants. He tells Michels he got this from others and does not name the people involved. If true, it would mean evidence of giants was taken out of public view by academics.
